overall_goal: Incorporate coconut milk into the curry mixture.

goals.description: Open the can of coconut milk.
goals.rationale: The person uses a can opener and a rinsed fork to open the can of coconut milk and check its texture.

goals.description: Transfer the coconut milk from the can into a bowl and mix it.
goals.rationale: The person decants the coconut milk into a bowl in batches, stirs it to an even consistency, and empties the can.

goals.description: Add the coconut milk to the pot and stir the mixture.
goals.rationale: The person pours the prepared coconut milk from the bowl into the cooking pot and stirs the curry.
